newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WALES STILL EXPECTED TO HOST AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WALES STILL EXPECTED TO HOST AUSTRALIA.

text.p: Wales said on Thursday they had heard nothing from Australia regarding the possible cancellation of the Wallabies' scheduled test at Cardiff Arms' Park on December 1.

The Australian Rugby Union (ARU) are keen to play tests against all four home unions on their forthcoming tour, but are struggling to agree a date with England and have suggested sacrificing the Welsh game to ensure a match at Twickenham.
"Australia have given no indication to Wales they will not honour the fixture," commented Welsh Rugby Union chairman Vernon Pugh. "We are looking forward to having them here on December 1."
